title: QA run · surface:api (116/130) · 580fd4ed · 2026-10-20 · 62 PASS / 54 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 14 NOT-RUN
body:
QA run record — 18.0 third-round supplementary sweep, server half (1): `surface:api` at framework `580fd4ed`. Maintainer-approved re-run (dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`, 2026-10-20). Wave anchor: #24579. Earlier rounds: round 1 at `5b14b7f3`, round 2 at `ba4afcc2` (Tier 1 record #24598; area records #24595 #24601 #24603 #24596 #24616 #24615 #24604 #24612 #24593).

Why this round: `ba4afcc2..580fd4ed` merged 87 commits (17 breaking), including the #24580 walled lift; 110 of the selector's 130 items had a source file touched in that range.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `580fd4ed3c98a1752dfb0041b45cc713644fef7e` (pinned, detached; no pull). `.objectui-sha` not built — this round needs no console (`pnpm objectui:build` not run; every UI leg is `not-run (browser)`).
- Container: cold tree. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (18 s) then `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (76/76 tasks, 6m23s); `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` green (70 artifacts).
- Tier 1: vitest per package, `--maxWorkers=1`, one package at a time, no server alive except the Tier 2 runners' own.
- Tier 2: two HTTP runners, each with its own boot and DB, never more than 2 servers alive:
  - runner A: port 41731, `-d file:/tmp/qa3/A/data.db` (scratch-app boot for the AI item: fresh `file:/tmp/qa3/A/scratch.db`);
  - runner B: port 41732, `-d file:/tmp/qa3/B/data.db` (scratch copy of the app for the install / OS_CLOUD_URL=off / two-factor / broken-MCP boots);
  - parent probes: port 41733, fresh DB per boot.
  - Boot line: `OS_PORT=PORT pnpm exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa3/X/data.db` from `examples/app-showcase`, posture `single`. Seed `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai). Boot banner: `Tenancy: single`, `Flows: 32 flow(s) 19 bound`, `Seeds: com.example.showcase 132 rows`.
- Timestamps (UTC, 2026-10-20): env prep 04:57 to 05:04; Tier 1 05:05 to 05:27; Tier 2 05:05 to 05:31; parent probes 05:29 to 05:45.
- Runners: Tier 1 by the parent session; Tier 2 by two runner subagents in parallel (own port and DB each), clause verdicts re-read by the parent.

## Scope

Selector `surface:api`, resolved by `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs surface:api --json` at `580fd4ed`: **130 runnable items** (1 blocked, hidden: `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`). No `planned` item matched. Per-item `revision` is in each table row below.

- **Tier 1** — 86 items with `automated.ref` (read from `areas/AREA.json`; the resolver does not project it). 254 named pin files across 34 packages (plus 12 closed-card fix pins, 35 packages in all), run per package; the verdict cites only the pin output (RUNNER rule 6). An item whose pins assert only some clauses is `partial`, and the uncovered clauses are named. Two items also name `objectstack verify --rls` as an oracle; it was run (below).
- **Tier 2** — 31 unpinned P0/P1 items, driven over HTTP on the stock showcase. Browser legs: `not-run (browser)`; only the server leg is judged.
- **Tier 3** — 13 unpinned P2 items, not run by plan (handover list below).
- **Walled legs**: this record provisions no walled boot. Every live walled leg is `blocked(fixture)` per RUNNER "A walled boot is a fixture of its own" (no example app declares `@objectstack/organizations`; no `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` / `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY`). The sister card S2 runs them. Where a Tier 1 pin drives the walled leg in-process, the clause rests on that pin, and the row says so.

No clause failed. No P0 failure. Tier 1 pin totals: **6689 / 6690 tests passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped** across 35 packages; every named pin file was collected and ran at least one test (none collected zero). The one skip is `packages/qa/dogfood/test/attachments-permission-matrix.dogfood.test.ts` case (g) "a member outside the admin org cannot read or delete the admin's attachments through /data" — a second-organization case, skipped by the suite itself on a single-org stack (fixture gap, below).

`objectstack verify --rls` (stock showcase, in-process): CRUD tail `15 verified, 0 gaps, 0 FAILED, 1 needs-fixture, 8 skipped (0 mismatches)`; per-persona probe line `21 PROVEN (21 consistent, 0 HOLES) · 3 NOT PROVEN`; total line `all personas: 38 PROVEN (38 consistent, 0 HOLES) · 226 NOT PROVEN … [unit: one object × persona probe]`; `10 of 10 declared position(s) probed`. Matches the RUNNER environment fact (same digits as 2026-10-01).

## Against round 2 (`ba4afcc2`)

- **PASS in round 2, FAIL now: none.** RUNNER rule 7 (independent re-derivation) therefore had nothing to verify; there is also no P0 fail.
- **FAIL in round 2, PASS now (3):**
  - `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix` — round-2 negative[2] FAIL (#24618, in-memory date bucketing shifted a day) now passes live in UTC / New York / Los Angeles / Tokyo; #24618's pin is green.
  - `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code` and `access-security.share-link-combined-gates` — the round-2 area FAILs were assertion defects re-pointed on #24579 §1; at the current revisions (3 / 3) their pins cover every clause.
- **PASS in round 2, PARTIAL now (16)** — no behaviour regressed; every one is a coverage statement:
  - the 3 Tier 2 items with a browser leg (`access-security.owd-save-gate` n0, `automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract` a6 Studio rail) or an unprovisionable arm (`automation.trigger-status-contract` a4, 503 `STORE_UNAVAILABLE`);
  - 13 Tier 1 items mapped clause by clause against the pins at their HEAD revision. Round 2 (#24598) mapped acceptance clauses only; this round also maps `negative[i]`, and re-derived 47 items whose revision, clause text or ref moved. Items: `access-security.public-form-withdrawal-layers`, `activation-write-operator-gate`, `meta-authoring-trail-and-audience-gates`, `deployment-tables-platform-only`; `ai.mcp-validate-expression`, `mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure`; `api-backend.second-object-exposure-and-internal-fields`, `meta-read-doors-v18`; `approvals.act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate`; `attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity`; `dashboards.analytics-exposure-gate-and-measure-aggregate`; `platform-core.activation-ledger-registration-home`, `settings-audit-secret-fingerprint`. The uncovered clause for each is in the Tier 1 table.
- `access-security.scope-depth-asymmetry` moves to NOT-RUN: its rev-3 `automated.ref` itself states that its pins are adjacent tests and assert none of its clauses (checklist-accuracy, below).
- 12 ids had no round-2 verdict (no round-2 record for ai / approvals / identity-auth, and `access-security.org-admin-assignment-boundary` is new); 66 of the 130 ids carry a higher revision than at `ba4afcc2`.
